stories.headline: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang to testify to US Congress amid scandal, reports say, as CFO Colette Kress replaces him as interim CEO – follow live
stories.summary: Nvidia’s value slumps by $888bn this week as scandal over longtime CEO’s two affairs, including with a suspected Chinese spy, engulfs chip maker Analysis: Jensen Huang built an AI kingdom. What now?

sources.title: The Guardian: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang to testify to US Congress amid scandal, reports say,…
Al Jazeera: Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress?
BBC News: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?
The Hill: Who is interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress?

stories.now: Al Jazeera: Huang has stepped down amid revelations about extramarital affairs and allegations of Chinese espionage. BBC News: The BBC's Samira Hussain reports from Wall Street on what the fall of the tech superstar means for the company and AI.
stories.backstory: Huang co-founded Nvidia and has run it since 1993, building it into the main supplier of the chips used to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems and one of the world's most valuable companies. Earlier this week, reports said the company had opened an internal investigation into whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort through a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly passed information to Beijing. Huang told staff in a company email that he had been unfaithful in his marriage. The stock had already slipped on that first report before Wednesday's news.

The Guardian: Hospital director says 28 wounded in attack on one of few remaining medical facilities in the strip An Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in southern Gaza killed six people, including a surgeon and a disabled man, and…
stories.backstory: The war began with the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, and Israel's military campaign has since destroyed much of Gaza's health system. Nasser Hospital is one of the few large medical facilities still working in the territory. A U.S.-backed ceasefire took effect on Oct. 10, 2025, but Israeli strikes have continued, with each side accusing the other of violations. Hospitals are protected under international humanitarian law unless they are used for military purposes.
